notes.title: A big Egg Update!
notes.content:
The time is finally here to get back into Kitchen Island VR and enjoy the major improvements we bring with this version. We had the chance to work with a QA Team and were able to fix a truckload of Bugs!

Furthermore we will bring all these new Features and Improvements to VR Cooking:

*NEW* Easter Egg Hunt Event! Collect as many eggs in the Game and deliver them to the Drones in this special Event until 30th of April
*NEW* Localization System Audio and Text (English, German and Chinese)
*NEW* Many visual improvements like Grabbing Outline of Objects

*FIX* Major Bug Fixes in the Area of Single- and Multiplayer Experience (Yes we finally could fix the "Not Grab anymore" Bug)
*FIX* Performance Issues

We hope that you are as happy as we are with this new version and as always, please contact us if you have suggestions, comments or whatever :-) 
The Kitchen Island VR Team wishes you a Happy Easter!

notes.title: The Big Bug Fix Edition
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40097327/3a625fd1d69ad2ddb0abac898aad4be358e9c1cd.png[/img]

Hi to all excited cooks out there, as promised we finally bring you the first [b]Big Bug Fix edition[/b]! 
With the help from the community we managed to tackle some of the biggest issues:
[list]
[*]*FIX* Big performance boost on HTC Vive, RiftS and hopefully all headsets :-)!
[*]*FIX* Bug that you couldn't grab anything 
[*]*FIX* Burger and Sushi building improved
[*]*FIX* Snap Rotation finally pivots around the player position
[*]*FIX* In Game Menu should open when the button is first pressed 
[*]*NEW* Mirror was quite heavy on performance and was replaced
[*]*NEW* 3-Player Multiplayer is possible on every island
[*]*NEW* Body Collision is "more" slim and smooth! Much better for a smaller Play Area
[/list]
We hope that it works much smoother for everybody now and you can enjoy cooking even more :-)
Please let us know if you experience any other bugs! We will try to fix everything as soon as possible!

Have a great weekend!
See you cooking soon...

notes.title: New Update coming soon!
notes.content:
Hi to all busy cooks out there! I just want to give you all a quick update what is going on with the next version of Kitchen Island VR :-)!
We received some bug reports and improvement requests and are currently working hard to implement them.

One of the most important things is of course the serious lag problem on some hardware.
We figured out that the mirror causes these major problems, so we are finding a solution for that ;-)

Furthermore we got reports about problem with the HTC Vive. This is of course also a big concern, so we will try to fix the controller issues with the next update as soon as possible! 

If you find any more bugs, please let us know! As a small team we can't always figure out all the bugs by ourselves. :-)
Follow us on Discord to receive even more updates and communicate with us: https://discord.gg/25Nhzbr

Hope to see you all cooking soon...
